text:
maria.g: Hey sec team — quick Q for a SOC2 questionnaire: customer wants to confirm whether we share logs with subprocessors and how we handle redaction/permissions. We're proposing to add LogStreamCo (managed logging/search) as a subprocessor for retained logs. Any immediate blockers?
tim.r: Do we run the forwarder inside our VPC? Also: KMS + key rotation questions. @ellen.p?
ellen.p: We use AWS KMS (alias: redwood/prod-logs) with automatic rotation. LogStreamCo would only receive redacted/pseudonymized logs via our forwarder. We need DPA + subprocessor agreement + limited fields. cc: @security-bot for checklist.
security-bot: Automated check: LogStreamCo is not on the approved vendors list. Required before sending any data: DPA, SOC2 attestation for vendor, a dataflow diagram showing where redaction happens, and a least-privilege IAM role. See https://redwood.internal/vendor-security#onboarding
maria.g: We have a draft DPA and vendor questionnaire answers. For redaction plan: remove PII fields (user_id, email, raw_prompt). We'll HMAC-SHA256 user_id and mask email. Sample config: 
```:redact
  - fields: ["email","raw_prompt"]
  - hash: ["user_id"]
  - mask_char: "*"
```
Is that sufficient for security review?
ivan: Hashing user_id is fine. For SOC2 evidence we need to show the redaction happens prior to export. Where does the forwarder run? If it's outside our control we need client-side redaction + E2E encryption.
ellen.p: Forwarder runs on our k8s cluster inside the VPC and posts to LogStreamCo over TLS. Storage at LogStreamCo is encrypted; for enterprise accounts we can require them to bring their own CMK. For standard flows we must ensure redaction occurs in-cluster before any outbound call. I suggest adding a pre-forward lambda sidecar to perform HMAC + masking.
maria.g: OK. Who can approve onboarding them? I need sign-off to finalize the questionnaire answer and DPA. @tim.r can you start the security approvals workflow?
tim.r: I'll submit to security-approvals@redwood and loop in Legal for the DPA. Meanwhile can someone draft a one-line for the customer questionnaire: 'We redact PII prior to export to subprocessors; access is role-based and logged; subprocessors undergo security review and are bound by DPA.' ?
ellen.p: LGTM. Also add: 'AWS KMS is used for key management; rotation enabled.'
security-bot: Note: Approval SLA = 3 business days. If you need expedited review add "expedite" to the email subject. Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec/checklist_onboard
ivan: One more operational item: I'll create a PR to restrict IAM so only forwarder-service-account can assume role log-forwarder-role. Will include terraform snippet and tests.
maria.g: Thanks — I'll hold off submitting the questionnaire until PR is merged. If no objections by EOD I'll submit.
tim.r: :thumbsup:
